reason: B is the better proposal because it adds a controlled, falsifiable comparison under impact-relevant loading with explicit ductility, strength, microstructure, and energy-release criteria. Although it largely repeats the demonstrated 0.1 at.% B result in HfMoNbTaTiZr and thus has limited novelty, testing whether that treatment preserves energetic performance under dynamic impact extends the cited work more substantively than A, which lacks a decisive experiment.
